sources.summary:
Title: Partnering with Hacktron to find vulnerabilities in OpenAI’s systems
Final URL: https://openai.com/index/partnering-with-hacktron/
Today we’re announcing a partnership with Hacktron to find vulnerabilities in OpenAI’s systems. Our engineers and Hacktron’s security researchers will choose high-priority areas to test together, with a focus on how our systems interact with third-party services. As part of the partnership, we’re expanding Hacktron’s access to our frontier models through [Dayb
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 值得读的是，OpenAI与Hacktron合作排查系统漏洞，重点测试与第三方服务的交互，并通过Daybreak Red扩大Hacktron对前沿模型的访问。

en.reason: OpenAI is partnering with Hacktron so engineers and security researchers jointly test high-priority areas, focusing on how OpenAI’s systems interact with third-party services and expanding Hacktron’s access to frontier models through Daybreak Red.

Title: Measuring how AI agents handle everyday wet-lab science
Final URL: https://openai.com/index/measuring-how-ai-agents-handle-wet-lab-science/
Our mission is to ensure that artificial general intelligence benefits all of humanity. As part of that mission, we want to help scientists accelerate biological research—from understanding disease to developing new treatments. For AI agents to contribute, they need to reliably interpret the experimental evidence scientists work with every day in wet
sources.recommend_reason_zh: OpenAI与Ligo推出含100个任务的BioBasicsBench，测试AI agent解读原始湿实验室数据、识别错误并判断证据不足的能力；GPT‑6 Astra在xhigh设置平均获得66.7%可用分，GPT‑5.6 Sol为43.8%。

en.reason: OpenAI and Ligo’s BioBasicsBench tests AI agents on 100 tasks interpreting raw wet-lab data, spotting errors and judging insufficient evidence, with GPT-6 Astra averaging 66.7% usable score under xhigh versus GPT-5.6 Sol’s 43.8%.

sources.title: Usage metrics API 新增代码审查详情与已处理率 / Usage metrics API adds code review details and addressed rate
sources.title_zh: Usage metrics API 新增代码审查详情与已处理率
sources.title_en: Usage metrics API adds code review details and addressed rate
sources.title_original: Usage metrics API adds code review details and addressed rate
sources.recommend_reason_zh: GitHub 的 Copilot 使用指标 API 在企业与组织仓库级报告中新增 copilot_code_review 对象，可统计 Copilot 审查的 PR 有多少在无人后续提出修改请求的情况下合并、开发者实际处理了多少条审查意见，并按仓库计算 addressed rate。

en.reason: GitHub's Copilot usage metrics API adds a copilot_code_review object to repos-1-day rows in enterprise and organization repository-level reports, showing how many Copilot-reviewed pull requests merged without later change requests, how many review comments developers addressed, and a per-repository addressed rate.

sources.recommend_reason_zh: Copilot usage metrics API 新增按用户字段和每日受影响人数，可识别缺少客户端遥测或 IDE/扩展版本低于最低要求的用户，这些用户仍计为活跃但缺少代码行数、功能与模型细分数据。

en.reason: The Copilot usage metrics API adds per-user fields and daily affected-user counts to enterprise and organization reports, flagging users missing client telemetry or below minimum IDE/extension versions who remain active but lack line-count and feature/model breakdowns.

sources.recommend_reason_zh: Anthropic本周起在美国向Claude的Pro、Max、Ultra订阅用户逐步推出只读理财功能，绑定银行卡后可汇总账户、按类别拆账并排查重复扣款，但无法转账、管理资金或投资。

en.title: It can read your bills but can't touch your money: Claude moves into personal finance
en.reason: Anthropic this week began rolling out read-only personal finance features in the U.S. to Claude Pro, Max and Ultra subscribers, letting them link bank cards to aggregate accounts, categorize spending and flag duplicate charges, but not transfer or invest funds.

sources.title_original: 蚂蚁百灵发布 Ling 3.2 Flash：三项核心基准超越 Claude Opus 5，前两周限时免费开放
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 蚂蚁百灵发布原生多模态模型 Ling-3.2-flash，560B总参数、25B激活参数与1M上下文，官方称三项基准超越 Claude Opus 5，其中 OmniDocBench 1.5 得92.21对90.56、ZEROBench (Sub) 得43.71对39.52，前两周限时免费。

en.title: Ant BaiLing releases Ling 3.2 Flash: beats Claude Opus 5 on three core benchmarks, free for the first two weeks
en.reason: Ant Bailing's native multimodal Ling-3.2-flash packs 560B total and 25B active parameters with 1M context, claims three benchmark wins over Claude Opus 5—OmniDocBench 1.5 92.21 vs 90.56 and ZEROBench (Sub) 43.71 vs 39.52—and is free for two weeks.

sources.title: v2.1.319
sources.summary:
What's changed

Changed auto mode with telemetry or feature flags off, including behind LLM gateways: calls the server can't check are asked about or denied, with no fallback to the built-in classi...
Claude Code is an agentic coding tool that lives in your terminal, understands your codebase, and helps you code faster by executing routine tasks, explaining complex code, and handling git workflows - all through natural language commands. - Release v2.1.319 · anthropics/claude-code
What's cha
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Claude Code v2.1.319 修改了 auto mode：当 telemetry 或 feature flags 关闭、包括经 LLM gateway 转发时，服务端无法核查的调用会被询问或拒绝，且不再回退到内置分类器。

en.reason: Claude Code v2.1.319 changes auto mode so that with telemetry or feature flags off, including behind LLM gateways, calls the server cannot check are queried or denied, with no fallback to the built-in classifier.

sources.summary:
Ricursive Intelligence is releasing Ripple-65B Preview, a 65-billion-parameter open-weight language model that the company says achieves the top score among open-source U.S. models on the TerminalBench 2.1 coding benchmark at a total R&D cost of $32 million. On other benchmarks, however, Ripple falls behind the likewise newly released western open model Inkling 2 Small.

en.reason: Ricursive Intelligence's Ripple-65B Preview, a 65-billion-parameter open-weight model under Apache 2.0 on Hugging Face, scores 80.52 on TerminalBench 2.1—the top U.S. open-model result—at $32 million R&D cost.

An experiment in which AI models were asked to break into simulated networks showed the hacking skills of DeepSeek and GLM to be not far behind OpenAI’s most advanced cyber model, which isn’t public.

sources.recommend_reason_zh: Vals实验显示，OpenAI仅限可信伙伴的Daybreak完成81%模拟网络攻击任务，DeepSeek平均完成73%，且攻击token成本仅2至3美元，远低于GPT-6-Sol的17至46美元，说明开放模型正逼近闭源前沿。

sources.title_en: Memorilla: Latent Semantic Memory for LLMs
sources.title_original: Memorilla: Latent Semantic Memory for LLMs
sources.summary: Memory enables large language models (LLMs) to use information beyond their parameters, such as past user conversations, long documents, or an agent's earlier actions. For a frozen LLM, access to this accumulated knowledge is limited to what a memory system places in its context window. However, gathering and combining relevant information needed for each query while keeping the model's context short remains challenging for existing systems. Here we introduce Memorilla, a memory system that gath
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Memorilla用16个memory tokens把整份文档集合压进冻结LLM，FactKG准确率84.33%反超全上下文推理的80.43%，表示源文档的token少108倍。

en.reason: Memorilla compresses an entire document collection into 16 memory tokens for a frozen LLM, reaching 84.33% on FactKG versus 80.43% for full-context reasoning while using 108x fewer source-document tokens.

en.reason: A 39-point Hacker News thread on Memorilla's paper about latent semantic memory for LLMs highlights jkingsman's reading that an intermediate model turns agent queries into token-efficient injected formats that skip actual text, strong on concepts but weaker at exact-text retrieval.

sources.recommend_reason_zh: 这篇 bug report 值得读：用户称每天收到数十封诈骗邮件，因 Claude Code 未经许可在网页搜索时把邮箱写进 User-Agent 请求头泄露给第三方，并批评这不该是 opt-out 设置，已将公司迁到 Pi with OpenRouter。

en.reason: A Claude Code user reports dozens of scam emails after the tool leaked their email in the User-Agent header during web searches without permission, says this should not be an opt-out setting, and moved their company to Pi with OpenRouter.

sources.title_original: ChatGPT上新功能！我做了一个批量生成动态表情包的Skill！
sources.summary: ChatGPT发布了Images 2.6，这次不只会画静态图片，也支持制作GIF了。看到这个更新，老金也尝试着做了动态表情包，一起看看效果如何！
sources.recommend_reason_zh: ChatGPT新发布的Images 2.6支持生成GIF，文章展示用Skill批量制作日常女友、大肥鱼、贱萌小鸽和憨憨河马四类动态表情包，并提到一键制作与直接变现尝试。

en.title: ChatGPT rolls out a new feature! I built a Skill that batch-generates animated stickers.
en.summary: ChatGPT has released Images 2.6, which now supports GIF creation alongside static images. Lao Jin decided to try making animated stickers with it—let's see how they turned out.
en.reason: ChatGPT's Images 2.6 now generates GIFs, and the author built a Skill to batch-produce four dynamic sticker sets—daily girlfriend, big fat fish, cheeky pigeon and naive hippo—while testing one-click creation and direct monetization.

sources.title_original: Claude code/Codex+Seedance AI视频：从一个想法到成片的全流程
sources.summary: 这篇文章只解决一个问题：怎么靠一套多模型工作流和实际操作过程中需要注意的事项，用尽量少的钱、尽量低的抽卡率，做出一条自己满意的AI视频。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 作者以Claude code为总导演，接入Codex与Seedance，并搭配ffmpeg和Python，按工具层与实操层拆解从想法到成片的多模型分工、提示词和视频抽卡，目标是少花钱、低抽卡率并给出完整提示词。

en.title: Claude Code / Codex + Seedance AI video: a full workflow from idea to finished film
en.summary: This article tackles a single question: how to use a multi-model workflow—plus the practical pitfalls to watch for—to produce an AI video you're happy with at minimal cost and with as few rerolls as possible.
en.reason: Claude Code acts as chief director alongside Codex, Seedance, ffmpeg and Python, splitting the idea-to-final-cut workflow into tool and practice layers with complete prompts to cut cost and video reroll rates.

sources.title: UI/3D/代码动画... 分享4大类能去掉AI味的新技巧
sources.title_zh: UI/3D/代码动画... 分享4大类能去掉AI味的新技巧
sources.title_original: UI/3D/代码动画... 分享4大类能去掉AI味的新技巧
sources.summary: 不少人苦恼没有Opus 5.5，做不出高质量的Vibe Coding动态作品。作者用商汤SenseNova-6.8-Flash，测试了代码动画、UI、3D、SVG动态海报四类生成效果，搭配自研的vibecoding-humanizer Skill优化去AI味，可以帮你用国产模型就做出接近标杆的动态作品。快来上手试试！
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 作者用商汤SenseNova-6.8-Flash裸跑15秒代码动画，并覆盖UI、3D、SVG动态海报四类，再以自制的vibecoding-humanizer重跑，对比Opus 5.5拆解字体与转场中的AI味。

en.title: UI/3D/code animation... 4 categories of new techniques to strip out that AI-generated feel
en.summary: Many people are frustrated that they can't produce high-quality Vibe Coding dynamic works without Opus 5.5. The author tested SenseTime's SenseNova-6.8-Flash across four generation categories—code animation, UI, 3D, and SVG motion posters—and paired it with a self-developed vibecoding-humanizer Skill to remove the AI feel, so you can create dynamic works close to the benchmark with a domestic model. Give it a try!
en.reason: The author runs SenseNova-6.8-Flash on a 15-second code animation and across UI, 3D and SVG poster generation, then reruns it with a self-built vibecoding-humanizer skill, comparing against Opus 5.5 to dissect AI tells in fonts and transitions.

stories.title: 评估：如何判断 AI 系统是否真正有效

sources.title: 评估：如何判断 AI 系统是否真正有效
sources.title_zh: 评估：如何判断 AI 系统是否真正有效
sources.title_original: 评估：如何判断 AI 系统是否真正有效
sources.summary: 这篇面向工程师、产品与管理者的分层评估指南，戳破了AI评测里常见的自欺陷阱。作者带大家拆解了代码评分器、模型裁判、幻觉检测器的适用边界，看完你也能搭建一套可落地、可信的评测流水线，用扎实的数据验证每一次迭代，避免分数好看、线上翻车。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 文章以自行车店80张客户支持工单为例，拆解LLM系统评估的输入、系统、评分器和数字流程，并提醒与人类仅60%一致性的评判模型可能掩盖产品问题，评分器本身也必须被测试。

en.title: Evaluation: How to tell if an AI system actually works
en.summary: This layered evaluation guide for engineers, product managers, and managers debunks the common self-deception traps in AI evaluation. The author breaks down where code graders, model judges, and hallucination detectors actually apply, so you can build a practical, trustworthy evaluation pipeline and validate every iteration with solid data—avoiding the trap of great scores and production failures.
en.reason: A bicycle-shop example with 80 customer-support tickets breaks LLM evaluation into inputs, system, graders and scoring, warning that a judge agreeing with humans only 60% of the time can hide product failures and must itself be tested.

sources.title_zh: 我试着用 ChatGPT 和 Claude 当 Android 助手，看看它们跟 Gemini 比起来怎么样
sources.title_en: I tried ChatGPT and Claude as my Android assistant; here's how they compare to Gemini
sources.title_original: I tried ChatGPT and Claude as my Android assistant; here's how they compare to Gemini
sources.summary:
One comes closer to Gemini than you'd think
One comes closer to Gemini than you'd think
One comes closer to Gemini than you'd think
Google has fully replaced Google Assistant with Gemini . But it's not your only option.
Android now lets you set other AI apps, like ChatGPT and Claude, as your default assistant. If you pay for either, it's tempting to use it everywhere.
I made each one my default assistant and gave it the same everyday tasks: alarms, texts, calendar events, directions, quick math,
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 作者实测将 ChatGPT 和 Claude 设为 Android 默认助手：ChatGPT 能算 18% 小费却无法操作手机，Claude 能设 6:30 闹钟和 10 分钟计时器、更接近 Gemini，但不能设提醒或打开 Maps。

en.reason: Set as Android's default assistant, ChatGPT can calculate an 18% tip but cannot operate the phone, while Claude sets a 6:30 alarm and 10-minute timer and comes closer to Gemini, though it cannot set reminders or open Maps.

stories.title: Claude Code 同需求写两版对比：装不装 frontend-design 差多远？

sources.title: Claude Code 同需求写两版对比：装不装 frontend-design 差多远？
sources.title_zh: Claude Code 同需求写两版对比：装不装 frontend-design 差多远？
sources.title_original: Claude Code 同需求写两版对比：装不装 frontend-design 差多远？
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 用5段提示词让Claude Code零手写代码搭在线切图工具，实测不调用frontend-design的index-v1.html耗时约3.5分钟但视觉朴素，点名启用后的index-v2.html耗时约5.5分钟并升级为专业暗灰工作台，还追加网格线、像素标注和自定义行列。

en.title: Claude Code, same requirement, two versions compared: how far apart is it with vs. without frontend-design installed?
en.reason: Five prompts and no hand-written code produced two Claude Code image-splitter builds: index-v1.html took about 3.5 minutes but looked plain, while enabling frontend-design yielded index-v2.html in about 5.5 minutes with a dark-gray workbench, grid lines, pixel annotations and custom rows/columns.

sources.title: 诉讼称：男子介绍妻子使用 ChatGPT，妻子却用它策划谋杀他 / Lawsuit: Man introduced his wife to ChatGPT. She used it to plan his murder.

sources.title_original: 3 takeaways from the big AI report on Anthropic everyone is talking about
sources.recommend_reason_zh: METR在Anthropic总部嵌入近三个月后发布首份报告，称其过去六个月已训练完三个未公开模型，内部Slack调查显示最强内部模型带来约12倍自报生产力提升，但多数证据被redacted。

en.reason: METR's first report after nearly three months embedded at Anthropic's San Francisco HQ says the company trained three unreleased models in six months, with an internal Slack survey reporting about 12x self-reported productivity gains, though most evidence is redacted.
